beats: My homepage's hero title used to have a faint dust smudge sitting on it — even at rest.
And a stray cursor flicker between tiles could restart the whole burst mid-flight.
Like a movie jumping back to its opening frame because someone coughed in the theater.
A single canvas component now stays invisible at rest, only bursting apart when you hover.
A 160-millisecond pause now swallows that flicker, holding the swirl to 7,000 grains so it never restarts.
